CRAS: dev_io - Add the overrun op threshold On grunt, the number of frames an input node reads once is decided by a period size, whose default vaule is 1024. According to the latest overrun ops, if the device's hw_level is larger than 2 * largest_cb_level, the audio thread will drop frames. However, the cb_level of capture streams are 256 from ARC++ and 480 from Chrome. Both of them * 2 are less than 1024, it causes the overrun ops will be triggered every time. To fix the problem, we can add the overrun op threshold. The op only works when the hw_level is larger than that threshold. That time must to be longer than 2048 frames with rate 48000 (grunt only supports 48000 rate). Therefore, we think 50ms is a reasonable threshold. For users, it means that the delay will be reduced only if it is larger than 50ms. The value is too small to affect the user experience. Notice that we can not fix the problem by changing a period size on grunt because it will change a buffer size, too. (Buffer size = 2 * period size on grunt. See #22 on b/112860209) BUG=b:138076270, chromium:918462 TEST=The capture frames is not dropped on grunt and the delay keeps in 50ms on panther. Change-Id: Ibe367a2075fb6a49b45cca1449c895321c824585 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1708817 Tested-by: Yu-Hsuan Hsu <yuhsuan@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Yu-Hsuan Hsu <yuhsuan@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org>

faft: modify using ccd logic Servo is going to have the capability to use servo micro and ccd with the same device. A lot of tests check if servo is using ccd to determine if the servo setup can press the power button. When servod uses servo micro and ccd to run, servo micro is the default device. The test is running through servo micro even if the servo type is servo_v4_with_servo_micro_and_with_ccd_cr50, modify all running using ccd checks, so it will check if the servo type is ccd_cr50 and not servo_micro.
